name: Dombrád (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, white and yellow in the ratio 1:6:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Dombrád: a blue and green shield with a yellow figure and a fish, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dombrád arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
